SELECT 
  traffic_source,
  MAX(monthly_rev) as highest_monthly_rev,
  MIN(monthly_rev) as lowest_monthly_rev,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(monthly_rev) - MIN(monthly_rev), 1000000), 2) as diff_millions
FROM (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source as traffic_source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source, month
)
WHERE traffic_source = '(direct)'
GROUP BY traffic_source

WITH daily_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    date AS day_date,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS daily_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY day_date
),
weekly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY week_start
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' AS traffic_source,
  (SELECT MAX(daily_revenue_millions) FROM daily_revenue) AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(weekly_revenue_millions) FROM weekly_revenue) AS max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) FROM monthly_revenue) AS max_monthly_product_revenue_millions

WITH first_visit AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
sessions_with_transactions AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date, device.deviceCategory AS transaction_device_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
    AND totals.transactions > 0
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date AS first_transaction_date, transaction_device_category
  FROM (
    SELECT fullVisitorId, date, transaction_device_category,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC) AS rn
    FROM sessions_with_transactions
  ) sub
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT fv.fullVisitorId
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.transaction_device_category = 'mobile'
  AND ft.first_transaction_date > fv.first_visit_date
ORDER BY fv.fullVisitorId

WITH state_drug_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    nppes_provider_state AS state,
    drug_name,
    SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claims
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
  WHERE nppes_provider_state IN ('AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA','ME','MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI','SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY')
  GROUP BY nppes_provider_state, drug_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    drug_name,
    total_claims,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY total_claims DESC) AS rn
  FROM state_drug_totals
)
SELECT state, drug_name, total_claims
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY state

WITH yearly_state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    _TABLE_SUFFIX AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1980' AND '1995'
  GROUP BY state, _TABLE_SUFFIX
),
ranked_states AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    year,
    event_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY event_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM yearly_state_counts
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT state, year, event_count
  FROM ranked_states
  WHERE rn <= 1000
)
SELECT 
  state,
  SUM(event_count) AS total_events
FROM filtered
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5

-- I have 27 stations with > 150 rainy days in 2023. 
-- Among them, 7 have fewer rainy days in 2023 than 2022:
-- 727815: STAMPASS PASS FLTWO (177 vs 198)
-- 727856: FELTS FIELD AIRPORT (220 vs 222)
-- 727857: PULLMAN MOSCOW RGNL (262 vs 264)
-- 727883: BOWERS FIELD AIRPORT (162 vs 164)
-- 727885: WILLIAM R FAIRCHILD (278 vs 280)
-- 727970: QUILLAYUTE AIRPORT (195 vs 212)
-- 727985: FRIDAY HARBOR (196 vs 294)

-- The question asks for "which weather stations" - so I should return the station names.

-- Final query:
WITH rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT g.stn, COUNT(*) as rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf
  WHERE s.state = 'WA' 
    AND g.stn != '999999'
    AND g.prcp != 99.99
    AND g.prcp > 0
  GROUP BY g.stn
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 150
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT g.stn, COUNT(*) as rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf
  WHERE s.state = 'WA' 
    AND g.stn != '999999'
    AND g.prcp != 99.99
    AND g.prcp > 0
  GROUP BY g.stn
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT usaf, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT name ORDER BY name)[OFFSET(0)] as name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'WA' AND usaf != '999999'
  GROUP BY usaf
)
SELECT r23.stn, sn.name, r23.rainy_days_2023, r22.rainy_days_2022
FROM rainy_2023 r23
JOIN rainy_2022 r22 ON r23.stn = r22.stn
JOIN station_names sn ON r23.stn = sn.usaf
WHERE r23.rainy_days_2023 < r22.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY r23.stn

WITH daily_precip AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    SUM(value) / 10.0 AS total_precip_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025' 
    AND element = 'PRCP' 
    AND qflag IS NULL 
    AND mflag IS NULL
    AND date >= '2016-01-01' 
    AND date <= '2016-12-31'
  GROUP BY date
),
daily_precip_with_rainy_flag AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    total_precip_mm,
    CASE WHEN total_precip_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END AS weather_condition
  FROM daily_precip
),
daily_citibike AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) AS trip_date,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE starttime >= '2016-01-01' AND starttime < '2017-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
)
SELECT 
  w.weather_condition,
  COUNT(*) AS num_days_with_data,
  SUM(COALESCE(c.trip_count, 0)) AS total_trips,
  AVG(COALESCE(c.trip_count, 0)) AS avg_daily_trips
FROM daily_precip_with_rainy_flag w
LEFT JOIN daily_citibike c ON w.date = c.trip_date
GROUP BY w.weather_condition

-- I notice Soissons Landing appears twice (stations 3181 and 3254). These are different stations with the same name.
-- This is fine - they're different station IDs but happen to share the same name in the trip data.
-- The question asks for "top 10 Citibike stations" so each station is counted separately.

-- The result looks correct. Let me finalize with a clean query that includes station_id for clarity
-- but the question only asks for station name/identifier and proportion.

SELECT 
  sn.start_station_name as station_name,
  t10.proportion
FROM (
  WITH same_station_trips AS (
    SELECT 
      start_station_id,
      starttime,
      bikeid
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
  ),
  bucketed AS (
    SELECT 
      start_station_id,
      starttime,
      bikeid,
      SAFE_CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime) / 2 AS INT64) as minute_bucket,
      EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hour_bucket,
      EXTRACT(DATE FROM starttime) as trip_date
    FROM same_station_trips
  ),
  window_counts AS (
    SELECT 
      start_station_id,
      trip_date,
      hour_bucket,
      minute_bucket,
      COUNT(*) as trip_count
    FROM bucketed
    GROUP BY start_station_id, trip_date, hour_bucket, minute_bucket
  ),
  group_windows AS (
    SELECT start_station_id, trip_date, hour_bucket, minute_bucket
    FROM window_counts
    WHERE trip_count > 1
  ),
  group_trips AS (
    SELECT b.start_station_id
    FROM bucketed b
    JOIN group_windows g
      ON b.start_station_id = g.start_station_id
      AND b.trip_date = g.trip_date
      AND b.hour_bucket = g.hour_bucket
      AND b.minute_bucket = g.minute_bucket
  ),
  group_trip_counts AS (
    SELECT start_station_id, COUNT(*) as group_trip_count
    FROM group_trips
    GROUP BY start_station_id
  ),
  total_end_counts AS (
    SELECT 
      end_station_id,
      COUNT(*) as total_end_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id
  ),
  top10 AS (
    SELECT 
      g.start_station_id,
      g.group_trip_count,
      t.total_end_count,
      SAFE_DIVIDE(g.group_trip_count, t.total_end_count) as proportion
    FROM group_trip_counts g
    JOIN total_end_counts t ON g.start_station_id = t.end_station_id
    ORDER BY proportion DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
  SELECT * FROM top10
) t10
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT start_station_id, start_station_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY start_station_id, start_station_name
  )
) sn ON t10.start_station_id = sn.start_station_id AND sn.rn = 1

WITH top_routes AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_name,
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
    ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
    ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
    ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_lon, start_lat, end_lon, end_lat
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
taxi_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as pickup_lon,
    ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as pickup_lat,
    ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as dropoff_lon,
    ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as dropoff_lat,
    AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration,
    COUNT(*) as taxi_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
  GROUP BY pickup_lon, pickup_lat, dropoff_lon, dropoff_lat
)
SELECT 
  tr.start_station_name,
  tr.end_station_name,
  tr.trip_count,
  tr.avg_bike_duration,
  ts.avg_taxi_duration
FROM top_routes tr
INNER JOIN taxi_stats ts 
  ON tr.start_lon = ts.pickup_lon 
  AND tr.start_lat = ts.pickup_lat
  AND tr.end_lon = ts.dropoff_lon
  AND tr.end_lat = ts.dropoff_lat
WHERE tr.avg_bike_duration < ts.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  tz.borough,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount * 100, t.total_amount) = 0 OR t.total_amount = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_tip_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount * 100, t.total_amount) = 0 OR t.total_amount = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as no_tip_percentage
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
  ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01' 
  AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
  AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
  AND t.passenger_count > 0
  AND t.trip_distance >= 0
  AND t.tip_amount >= 0
  AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
  AND t.fare_amount >= 0
  AND t.total_amount >= 0
GROUP BY tz.borough
ORDER BY tz.borough

WITH borough_station_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
stations_with_ada_entrance AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.borough_name,
    s.station_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` e
    ON s.station_name = e.station_name
  WHERE e.entry = TRUE
    AND e.ada_compliant = TRUE
)
SELECT 
  b.borough_name,
  b.total_stations,
  COUNT(s.station_name) AS stations_with_ada_entrance,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(s.station_name) / b.total_stations, 2) AS percentage
FROM borough_station_counts b
LEFT JOIN stations_with_ada_entrance s
  ON b.borough_name = s.borough_name
GROUP BY b.borough_name, b.total_stations
ORDER BY percentage DESC;

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT
    trip_id,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(duration_sec, 60) AS duration_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    duration_min,
    start_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year_month ORDER BY start_date ASC) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year_month ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM trips
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS first_trip_duration,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS last_trip_duration
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT
  fl.year_month,
  fl.first_trip_duration,
  fl.last_trip_duration,
  t.highest_trip_duration,
  t.lowest_trip_duration
FROM first_last fl
JOIN (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    MAX(duration_min) AS highest_trip_duration,
    MIN(duration_min) AS lowest_trip_duration
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY year_month
) t ON fl.year_month = t.year_month
ORDER BY fl.year_month;

WITH trips_with_region AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trip_id,
    t.duration_sec,
    t.start_date,
    t.start_station_name,
    r.name AS region_name,
    t.member_gender,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.name ORDER BY t.start_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` si 
    ON CAST(t.start_station_id AS STRING) = si.station_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r 
    ON si.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_date) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2017
)
SELECT 
  region_name,
  trip_id,
  duration_sec,
  start_date,
  start_station_name,
  member_gender
FROM trips_with_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_name

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as station_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, s.station_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
),
incident_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as incident_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` i
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(i.longitude, i.latitude))
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT 
  sc.neighborhood,
  sc.station_count,
  ic.incident_count
FROM station_counts sc
INNER JOIN incident_counts ic ON sc.neighborhood = ic.neighborhood
ORDER BY sc.neighborhood
LIMIT 12 OFFSET 50

WITH age_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN age < 25 THEN population ELSE 0 END) AS pop_under_25,
    SUM(population) AS total_pop
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2017
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT 
  country_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(pop_under_25, total_pop) * 100, 2) AS pct_under_25
FROM age_data
ORDER BY pct_under_25 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT country_name, cumulative_confirmed, cumulative_recovered,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) AS recovery_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = DATE('2020-05-10')
  AND aggregation_level = 0
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT facility_place_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_vaccination_access.facility_boundary_us_all` WHERE facility_sub_region_1 = 'California'),
    (SELECT SUM(total_pop) FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%')
  ) * 1000 AS vaccine_sites_per_1000_people

SELECT 
    b.country_name,
    b.net_migration,
    c.country_area
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.birth_death_growth_rates` b
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.country_names_area` c
    ON b.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE b.year = 2017
    AND c.country_area > 500
ORDER BY b.net_migration DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH 
historical AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    'win' AS label,
    win_seed AS seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    lose_seed AS opponent_seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    season,
    'loss' AS label,
    lose_seed AS seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    win_seed AS opponent_seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
),
tournament_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    label,
    seed,
    school_ncaa,
    opponent_seed,
    opponent_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.2018_tournament_results`
),
all_games AS (
  SELECT * FROM historical
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM tournament_2018
)
SELECT 
  ag.season,
  ag.label,
  ag.seed,
  ag.school_ncaa,
  ag.opponent_seed,
  ag.opponent_school_ncaa,
  t.pace_rank,
  t.poss_40min AS pace_stat,
  t.pace_rating,
  t.efficiency_rank AS eff_rank,
  t.pts_100poss AS eff_stat,
  t.efficiency_rating,
  o.pace_rank AS opp_pace_rank,
  o.poss_40min AS opp_pace_stat,
  o.pace_rating AS opp_pace_rating,
  o.efficiency_rank AS opp_eff_rank,
  o.pts_100poss AS opp_eff_stat,
  o.efficiency_rating AS opp_eff_rating,
  o.pace_rank - t.pace_rank AS pace_rank_diff,
  o.poss_40min - t.poss_40min AS pace_stat_diff,
  o.pace_rating - t.pace_rating AS pace_rating_diff,
  o.efficiency_rank - t.efficiency_rank AS eff_rank_diff,
  o.pts_100poss - t.pts_100poss AS eff_stat_diff,
  o.efficiency_rating - t.efficiency_rating AS eff_rating_diff
FROM all_games ag
LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` t 
  ON ag.school_ncaa = t.team AND ag.season = t.season
LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` o 
  ON ag.opponent_school_ncaa = o.team AND ag.season = o.season

WITH base_2014 AS (
  SELECT race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men, gender_global_women, gender_global_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2014
),
base_2022 AS (
  SELECT race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men, gender_global_women, gender_global_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year = 2022
)
SELECT 'Asian' AS demographic_group, ROUND((b2.race_asian - b1.race_asian) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_pct_points
FROM base_2014 b1, base_2022 b2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Black people', ROUND((b2.race_black - b1.race_black) * 100, 1)
FROM base_2014 b1, base_2022 b2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Latinx people', ROUND((b2.race_hispanic_latinx - b1.race_hispanic_latinx) * 100, 1)
FROM base_2014 b1, base_2022 b2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Native Americans', ROUND((b2.race_native_american - b1.race_native_american) * 100, 1)

SELECT 
  a.id AS answer_id,
  au.reputation AS answerer_reputation,
  a.score AS answer_score,
  a.comment_count AS answer_comment_count,
  q.tags AS question_tags,
  q.score AS question_score,
  q.answer_count AS question_answer_count,
  qu.reputation AS asker_reputation,
  q.view_count AS question_view_count,
  q.comment_count AS question_comment_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` au ON a.owner_user_id = au.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` qu ON q.owner_user_id = qu.id
WHERE 
  -- Question posted in January 2016
  q.creation_date >= TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01') 
  AND q.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2016-02-01')
  -- Answer posted in January 2016
  AND a.creation_date >= TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01') 
  AND a.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2016-02-01')
  -- Question has javascript tag
  AND (
    q.tags LIKE '%|javascript|%' 
    OR q.tags LIKE 'javascript|%' 
    OR q.tags LIKE '%|javascript' 
    OR q.tags = 'javascript'
  )
  -- Question has at least one of the security tags
  AND (
    q.tags LIKE '%|xss|%' OR q.tags LIKE 'xss|%' OR q.tags LIKE '%|xss' OR q.tags = 'xss'
    OR q.tags LIKE '%|cross-site|%' OR q.tags LIKE 'cross-site|%' OR q.tags LIKE '%|cross-site' OR q.tags = 'cross-site'
    OR q.tags LIKE '%|exploit|%' OR q.tags LIKE 'exploit|%' OR q.tags LIKE '%|exploit' OR q.tags = 'exploit'
    OR q.tags LIKE '%|cybersecurity|%' OR q.tags LIKE 'cybersecurity|%' OR q.tags LIKE '%|cybersecurity' OR q.tags = 'cybersecurity'
  )
  -- Answer is the accepted answer
  AND q.accepted_answer_id = a.id

WITH answers AS (
  SELECT 
    a.id as answer_id,
    q.tags,
    a.creation_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND a.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    v.post_id,
    COUNTIF(v.vote_type_id = 2) as upvote_count,
    COUNTIF(v.vote_type_id = 1) as accepted_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` v
  WHERE v.vote_type_id IN (1, 2)
  GROUP BY v.post_id
),
answer_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    a.answer_id,
    a.tags,
    COALESCE(av.upvote_count, 0) as upvote_count,
    COALESCE(av.accepted_count, 0) as accepted_count,
    10 * COALESCE(av.upvote_count, 0) + 15 * COALESCE(av.accepted_count, 0) as score
  FROM answers a
  LEFT JOIN answer_votes av ON a.answer_id = av.post_id
)
SELECT 
  tag,
  SUM(score) as total_score
FROM answer_scores,
UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) as tag
GROUP BY tag
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.doc_id, a.molregno, a.standard_type, 
         a.standard_value, a.standard_relation, 
         SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pv, a.potential_duplicate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
),
mol_assay_counts AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno,
         COUNT(*) AS act_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dup_count
  FROM filtered_activities
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
  HAVING act_count < 5 AND dup_count < 2
),
qualified_activities AS (
  SELECT fa.*
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN mol_assay_counts mac ON fa.assay_id = mac.assay_id AND fa.standard_type = mac.standard_type AND fa.molregno = mac.molregno
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT fa1.activity_id AS activity_id_1, fa2.activity_id AS activity_id_2,
         fa1.assay_id, fa1.standard_type,
         fa1.molregno AS molregno_1, fa2.molregno AS molregno_2,
         fa1.standard_value AS sv1, fa2.standard_value AS sv2,
         fa1.standard_relation AS sr1, fa2.standard_relation AS sr2,
         fa1.doc_id AS doc_id_1, fa2.doc_id AS doc_id_2
  FROM qualified_activities fa1
  JOIN qualified_activities fa2 ON fa1.assay_id = fa2.assay_id 
    AND fa1.standard_type = fa2.standard_type 
    AND fa1.molregno != fa2.molregno
  WHERE fa1.activity_id < fa2.activity_id
),
mol_info AS (
  SELECT cp.molregno AS molregno, cp.heavy_atoms, cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT doc_id, journal, 
         COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) AS year,
         SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64) AS first_page_int,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970)) AS grp_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
),
doc_pub_dates AS (
  SELECT doc_id,
         year,
         CASE WHEN grp_size = 1 THEN 1 
              ELSE SAFE_CAST(FLOOR(((rn - 1) * 1.0 / (grp_size - 1)) * 11) + 1 AS INT64) 
         END AS month,
         CASE WHEN grp_size = 1 THEN 1 
              ELSE MOD(SAFE_CAST(FLOOR(((rn - 1) * 1.0 / (grp_size - 1)) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 
         END AS day
  FROM doc_dates
),
pair_data AS (
  SELECT p.activity_id_1, p.activity_id_2,
         p.assay_id, p.standard_type,
         p.sv1, p.sv2,
         p.doc_id_1, p.doc_id_2,
         COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(mi1.heavy_atoms AS INT64), 0) AS ha1,
         COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(mi2.heavy_atoms AS INT64), 0) AS ha2,
         mi1.canonical_smiles AS smiles_1,
         mi2.canonical_smiles AS smiles_2,
         dpd1.year AS year1, dpd1.month AS month1, dpd1.day AS day1,
         dpd2.year AS year2, dpd2.month AS month2, dpd2.day AS day2
  FROM pairs p
  LEFT JOIN mol_info mi1 ON p.molregno_1 = mi1.molregno
  LEFT JOIN mol_info mi2 ON p.molregno_2 = mi2.molregno
  LEFT JOIN doc_pub_dates dpd1 ON p.doc_id_1 = dpd1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN doc_pub_dates dpd2 ON p.doc_id_2 = dpd2.doc_id
),
with_dates AS (
  SELECT *,
    CONCAT(
      CAST(COALESCE(year1, 1970) AS STRING), '-',
      LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(month1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
      LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(day1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ) AS pub_date_1,
    CONCAT(
      CAST(COALESCE(year2, 1970) AS STRING), '-',
      LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(month2, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
      LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(day2, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0')
    ) AS pub_date_2
  FROM pair_data
),
with_latest_date AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE 
      WHEN pub_date_1 >= pub_date_2 THEN pub_date_1 
      ELSE pub_date_2 
    END AS latest_pub_date
  FROM with_dates
)
SELECT 
  activity_id_1,
  activity_id_2,
  GREATEST(ha1, ha2) AS max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_pub_date,
  GREATEST(doc_id_1, doc_id_2) AS highest_doc_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(sv1 AS FLOAT64) > SAFE_CAST(sv2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'decrease'
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(sv1 AS FLOAT64) < SAFE_CAST(sv2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'increase'
    ELSE 'no-change'
  END AS change_type,
  to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_1, smiles_1)))) AS uuid_1,
  to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_2, smiles_2)))) AS uuid_2
FROM with_latest_date

WITH top5_2008 AS (
  SELECT minor_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
year_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT c.year, t.minor_category, SUM(c.value) as crime_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` c
  JOIN top5_2008 t ON c.minor_category = t.minor_category
  GROUP BY c.year, t.minor_category
)
SELECT 
  yt.year,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc.crime_count, yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as pct_other_theft,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc2.crime_count, yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as pct_theft_from_motor_vehicle,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc3.crime_count, yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as pct_possession_of_drugs,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc4.crime_count, yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as pct_burglary_in_dwelling,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc5.crime_count, yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) as pct_assault_with_injury
FROM year_totals yt
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc ON yt.year = cc.year AND cc.minor_category = 'Other Theft'
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc2 ON yt.year = cc2.year AND cc2.minor_category = 'Theft From Motor Vehicle'
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc3 ON yt.year = cc3.year AND cc3.minor_category = 'Possession Of Drugs'
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc4 ON yt.year = cc4.year AND cc4.minor_category = 'Burglary in a Dwelling'
LEFT JOIN category_counts cc5 ON yt.year = cc5.year AND cc5.minor_category = 'Assault with Injury'
ORDER BY yt.year

WITH user_months AS (
  SELECT `by` as username, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2024-09-10')
    AND `by` IS NOT NULL
    AND `by` != ''
  GROUP BY `by`, activity_month
),
user_first_last AS (
  SELECT username, MIN(activity_month) as first_month, MAX(activity_month) as last_month
  FROM user_months
  GROUP BY username
),
-- Users with gaps within span AND whose last activity is before Sept 2024
users_with_inactive_month AS (
  SELECT fl.username, 
         DATE_DIFF(DATE_ADD(fl.last_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), fl.first_month, MONTH) + 1 as inactive_month_number
  FROM user_first_last fl
  WHERE fl.last_month < DATE('2024-09-01')
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_months um WHERE um.username = fl.username) 
        < DATE_DIFF(fl.last_month, fl.first_month, MONTH) + 1
)
SELECT username, inactive_month_number
FROM users_with_inactive_month
ORDER BY inactive_month_number DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Get just the top cohort with highest 4th-week retention
WITH user_first AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_event_date,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_event_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_event_date)) - 2) DAY) as cohort_monday
  FROM user_first
),
user_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
),
user_events_with_week AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.user_pseudo_id,
    uc.cohort_monday,
    DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ud.event_date), uc.cohort_monday, DAY) as day_diff,
    FLOOR(DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ud.event_date), uc.cohort_monday, DAY) / 7) as week_offset
  FROM user_days ud
  JOIN user_cohort uc ON ud.user_pseudo_id = uc.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  cohort_monday,
  COUNT(*) as cohort_size,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_offset = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as returned_week4,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN week_offset = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)) as retention_rate
FROM user_events_with_week
GROUP BY cohort_monday
ORDER BY retention_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH first_qp_per_user AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) as first_quickplay_timestamp
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180915'
    AND event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
first_qp_type AS (
  SELECT 
    fpu.user_pseudo_id,
    fpu.first_quickplay_timestamp,
    e.event_name as quickplay_event_type,
    e.event_date as first_quickplay_date_str
  FROM first_qp_per_user fpu
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON fpu.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_timestamp = fpu.first_quickplay_timestamp
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    quickplay_event_type,
    first_quickplay_timestamp,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_quickplay_date_str) as first_quickplay_date
  FROM first_qp_type
  WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_quickplay_date_str) BETWEEN DATE '2018-08-01' AND DATE '2018-08-15'
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.quickplay_event_type,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'session_start' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) >= DATE_ADD(c.first_quickplay_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY)
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) < DATE_ADD(c.first_quickplay_date, INTERVAL 15 DAY)
  GROUP BY c.user_pseudo_id, c.quickplay_event_type
)
SELECT quickplay_event_type,
       COUNT(*) as total_users,
       SUM(retained) as retained_users,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained), COUNT(*)), 4) as retention_rate
FROM retention
GROUP BY quickplay_event_type
ORDER BY retention_rate ASC
